description: Volumetric per-ROI DF/F, re-timed onto the ephys (Blackrock NS5) master clock. Each imaging trial is anchored to its matched ephys trial's stim onset (the shared TTL event); catch trials are anchored to ephys trial_start. Per-ROI DF/F computed as in the ophys-only pipeline (A1 footprint average of pre/mid 4D stacks; baseline = mean of pre frames). Rate = 30.125 Hz per-plane; inter-trial samples are NaN.
